heroHeadline: Day 179: Federal Raid on 'Tío Lako' Cell in Michoacán Detains 9, Triggers Retaliatory Blockades Across a Dozen Municipalities
heroSubtitle: Day 179 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). TÍO LAKO CELL RAID + BLOCKADES (Aug 19): Federal forces raided cells tied to regional CJNG commander Heraclio Guerrero Martínez ('Tío Lako') in Tanhuato and Ecuandureo, Michoacán, detaining 9 people — including his daughter and romantic partner — and seizing heavy weapons, grenade launchers, IEDs, and a drone. CJNG retaliated within hours with roadblocks and vehicle burnings across roughly a dozen Michoacán municipalities (Zamora, La Piedad, Pátzcuaro, and others); Jalisco reinforced its state border in response, and Guanajuato raised its alert level. No casualties reported. LORET AUDIO LINKS ANDY LÓPEZ BELTRÁN CIRCLE TO CJNG (Aug 18): Carlos Loret de Mola released 2023 audio in which associates of Morena's Andrés 'Andy' López Beltrán discuss coordinating with a CJNG fuel-theft cell in Veracruz via operator Iván Cazarín Molina ('El Tanque'); López Beltrán has not specifically rebutted the release. LOS DELTAS RAIDS (Aug 17): 11 alleged members of CJNG armed-wing cell 'Los Deltas' linked to prosecution after three Zapopan, Jalisco raids. COSTA RICA 1-TON SEIZURE (Aug 16): Costa Rican/DEA operation seized ~991kg of cocaine tied to a CJNG-linked network — the country's largest 2026 bust. DEA 'GLOBAL HUNT' DECLARED (Aug 13): DEA Administrator Terry Cole announced an international campaign against CJNG from Tampa, FL, invoking its foreign-terrorist-organization designation. AMBASSADOR JOHNSON: 'INTERNATIONAL REACH IS VULNERABILITY' (Aug 12): U.S. Ambassador Ronald Johnson told Mexican press — 'El alcance internacional del CJNG también es su vulnerabilidad... dondequiera que operen, los perseguiremos.' 19 CJNG MEMBERS SENTENCED (Aug 10): A Jalisco court sentenced 19 CJNG members to 16-18 years for a 2022 Tizapán el Alto arms cache; to serve time at Puente Grande. DOJ/STATE $102M REWARD PACKAGE (Aug 5): El 03's bounty raised to $25M, plus $15M each for El Jardinero, El Sapo, and El Chorro. SUCCESSION BINARY HOLDS: El 03 (confirmed leader, $25M) vs. El Sapo (military wing/Puerto Vallarta plaza boss, $15M) — both remain at large. DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13), El R-1/Los Rs (arrested Jul 30). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 48+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
